items.title: 7.7 Nataij aur faislon ka abalagh (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of communicating results and conclusions (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Nataij aur faislon ka abalagh data tajzie aur research ka ahem qadam hai. Yeh parhne walon ko samajhne mein madad deta hai ke data kya dikhata aur kaun se faisle ho sakte hain, taake nataij ki ghalat-fehmi ya ghalat istemal na ho. Nataij saade aur mantiqi tareeqe se samjhane chahiye, aur faisle sirf tajzia shuda data par mabni hon. Achha abalagh shaffafiyat aur aitbaar barhata aur aage ki research mein madad deta hai.

items: Test nataij ki tashreeh: shumariyati nataij (p-values, confidence levels, test statistics) ka matlab samjhein, tay karein ke hypothesis ki tayeed hoti hai ya nahi, aur data ka siyaq-o-sabaq dekhein; ghalat tashreeh ghalat nataij deti hai.
Nataij wazeh pesh karna: nataij mantiqi tarteeb mein, tables, charts aur graphs ke saath, mushkil istilahat ke bajaye saadi zaban, aur aham nukat numayan.

Nataij ko hypotheses se jorna: wazeh batayein ke har asal hypothesis ki tayeed hui ya nahi, data aur test nataij se is ka jawaz dein, aur zaati raye nateeje se bahar rakhein. Is se research ka amal mukammal hota hai.

blocks.text: Misal: tadrees ke tareeqe wale test ki reporting

7.4 ki misal ki wazeh report yeh kahegi: 'Humne jaancha ke kya naya tareeqa-e-tadrees number pichhle average 70 se oopar le jata hai. Is tareeqe se parhe das talaba ka average 77 (standard deviation 2.79) tha. One-tailed t-test ne t = 7.93 diya aur p 0.05 se bohat kam tha, is liye hum null hypothesis radd karte hain: tareeqa number behtar karta lagta hai. Namoona chhota aur be-tarteeb nahi chuna gaya tha, is liye bari tehqeeq ki sifarish hai.'

blocks.prompt: Report mein tehqeeq ki hudood, jaise chhota namoona, kyun batani chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake parhne wale nateeje par saboot se zyada bharosa na karein: chhota ya ghair-numainda namoona poori population ki akkasi nahi kar sakta, aur yeh batana abalagh ko imandar rakhta aur aage ki research ki rehnumai karta hai.

items: Nataij siyaq-o-sabaq mein samjhein; mubaligha na karein.
Tables, charts aur saadi zaban se nataij wazeh.
Har nateeja apne hypothesis se, saboot aur hudood ke saath.
